fields.finding: SK99's 135.881 kg nominal-SF1 chemistry-only film at 041 does not establish sustained-load suitability. The patent's 900 MPa/30°C rates give 39.6825 h (SK99) and 213.6752 h (DM20) to 1% strain if held constant.
fields.evidence: Patent PDF page 12, paragraphs 0099/0106/0107 visually inspected; UHMWPE-CREEP.csv reproduced. Required ten-year rate is 3.170979e-9 %/s. The 900 MPa comparison film weighs 338.220 kg and that stress is not qualified.
fields.needed: Obtain grade-specific creep/rupture/strain limits and hot aged laminate data. Neither patent rate nor another yarn's oxidative ageing law proves a ten-year installed SK99 or DM20 design.

claim: SK99's 135.881 kg nominal-SF1 chemistry-only film at 041 does not establish sustained-load suitability. The patent's 900 MPa/30°C rates give 39.6825 h (SK99) and 213.6752 h (DM20) to 1% strain if held constant.
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: The common equations do not qualify the bond, core law, coatings or installed safety factor. Carry the exact conventions, not an interchangeable headline. [052 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:3a70e117fbb14e85), [CHECK053](unpublished-local-ref:599d3a276c2fcbce).
